description: PolicySpace2 simulates housing, credit, labour and goods markets with spatially represented households, firms and municipalities. The repository documents a Python agent-based model extending PolicySpace and references multiple publications and a reviewed model deposit. It supports policy experiments with user-supplied regional inputs. Modelled policy effects remain conditional on calibration and behavioural assumptions. Published by BAFurtado (repository owner). Spatial and temporal resolution are source-dependent; any detail not stated above remains unknown. Access is through the provider documentation and software links; no software was installed. Reuse licence: MIT. The described release is free to access; licence restrictions still apply. Potential simulation uses include capacity planning, optimisation. Related catalogue records: platform-qgis. These are contextual links, not a claim of a tested integration.
